title: HILIC-MS/MS Method for Quantification of Phospholipid Classes
author: Mazzella, Moreira, et al.
materials: Lipid extracts were analyzed with a Dionex Ultimate 3000 HPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific, France). An API 2000 tandem mass spectrometer (Sciex, France) was used for detection. Chromatographic separation of phospholipids was performed on a Luna NH2 HILIC (3 µm, 100 × 2 mm) with a Security Guard cartridge NH2 (4 × 2.0 mm). The injection volume and temperature column were set to 20 µL and 40 °C, respectively. steps.title: Prepare Sample and Surrogate
steps.instruction: Add 150 mg of microbeads (0.5 mm diameter) and 10–20 mg (dry mass) of biological sample (e.g., microalgae cultures or fish larvae) into 2 mL microtubes. Add 50 µL of PE (2 × 15:0) surrogate solution at 100 ng.µL−1 prior to extraction.

steps.title: Perform First Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first extraction on ice to prevent enzymatic activity.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of MTBE:MeOH (3:1, v/v) mixture and 650 µL of UPW:MeOH (3:1, v/v) mixture.
Homogenize and lyse the sample using a FastPrep-24 5 G for 3 cycles of 15 s.
Centrifuge (Eppendorf 5430R) at 12,000 RPM to separate phases.
Collect 600 µL of the upper lipophilic phase (MTBE).

steps.title: Perform Second Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Carry out a second extraction on the residual hydrophilic phase on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL of MTBE:MeOH (3:1, v/v) and 455 µL of UPW:MeOH (3:1, v/v) mixtures.
Homogenize for 3 cycles of 15 s.
Centrifuge and collect 600 µL of the MTBE supernatant.
Combine this with the first collected phase to obtain a total of 1.1 mL of lipophilic organic phase.

steps.title: Prepare Extract for Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the combined lipophilic phases for HILIC-ESI-MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Store extracts at -80 °C if not analyzed immediately.
Add 50 µL of internal standards (PC, PG, PS, PE (2 × 17:0), and PI (17:0_20:4)) at a concentration of 33.3 ng.µL−1.
Evaporate MTBE using a gentle stream of N2.
Dilute the residue in an appropriate volume (typically 250–1000 µL) of isopropanol.
Store the final sample at -18 °C for up to 1 week until injection.

steps.title: Configure HILIC-ESI MS/MS System
steps.instruction: Set up the HPLC and Mass Spectrometer with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: HPLC: Dionex Ultimate 3000 with a Luna NH2 HILIC column (3 µm, 100 × 2 mm) and Security Guard cartridge NH2 (4 × 2.0 mm).
Column Temperature: 40 °C.
Injection Volume: 20 µL.
Mobile Phase: 40 mM ammonium acetate buffer (pH 6.8) and Acetonitrile.
Gradient: 0-2 min (95% ACN, 5% buffer), 2-7 min (linear decrease to 70% ACN, 30% buffer), 7-10 min (70% ACN, 30% buffer), 10-11 min (return to 95% ACN, 5% buffer), 11-13.7 min (95% ACN, 5% buffer).
Flow Rate: 400 µL.min−1.

steps.title: Set Mass Spectrometry Parameters
steps.instruction: Operate the API 2000 tandem mass spectrometer in negative ionization mode using the following settings:

substeps.instruction: General Settings: Curtain gas 30 psi, CAD 3-4500 V, IonSpray 450 °C, Ion source gas 1 30 psi, Ion source gas 2 60 psi.
Specific Class Settings (DP/CE): PE (-50V/-50V), PG (-100V/-50V), PC (-100V/-50V), PI (-60V/-50V), PS (-100V/-50V).
Acquisition Period 1 (0-6.8 min): Dedicated to PC, PE, and PG; dwell time 3-5 ms per transition (total acquisition time 1.631 s).
Acquisition Period 2 (after 6.8 min): Dedicated to PI and PS; dwell time 5-10 ms per transition (total acquisition time 1.764 s).
Pause time: 0.1 ms between mass ranges.

steps.title: Perform Quantitation and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify phospholipids using class-specific standards and internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Use internal standards: PC (2 × 17:0), PE (2 × 17:0), PG (2 × 17:0), PI (17:0_20:4), and PS (2 × 17:0) at approximately 1 µg.mL−1.
Inject analytical blanks and two quality controls (0.2 and 2 µg.mL−1) regularly during each batch.
